column2: Southwest of the Empire and west of the Holy Nation is the Six Kingdoms Alliance, made of six countries.{wait}{clear}The six kingdoms, Labirk, Celesta, Lanas, Lefkas, Frezelecia and Basel, do loads of trade, so they're super rich!{wait}{clear}The central city is Alkmaar, in Basel. Ships leave from Suore, in Labirk, and it looks like you can cross to the island in the west.{wait}{clear}

The biggest island in Arcaya, out in the Athlone Sea to the west, is Bremes Island.{wait}{clear}People only started living there a few hundred years ago, so it's kind of a new place.{wait}{clear}But there's a big mountain range running east to west, so there isn't much flat land, and it doesn't seem like a very lucky place.{wait}{clear}The Kavakia peninsula, southwest of the continent, is wild land. Most of the peninsula is a forest called the Reyforia Forest.{wait}{clear}Hardly anyone comes there from the continent. But there are tribespeople who've always lived in the forest.{wait}{clear}They've got their own culture and way of life and stuff, and they still tell a lot of their legends and myths.{wait}{clear}

At the very south of the continent is the Kingdom of Legrance, and its capital is Fanlan, in Ellora.{wait}{clear}It used to be split into east and west, but about fifty years ago the two royal families joined up and it became the Kingdom of Legrance.{wait}{clear}It hasn't been one country for long, and the old countries were different, so it's got lots of problems, I guess.{wait}{clear}

And that's Arcaya, Angel!{wait}{clear}I said it all at once, so that was tough, huh? But hang in there!{wait}{clear}So, can you give me my search orders now? I'll try really, really hard!{wait}{clear}
Oh... okay. Then can you give me my search orders now?{wait}{clear}
Um, Angel, this is Arcaya, the world below.{wait}{clear}It's the first time you've come down here, so I thought I'd explain it... Would you like to hear?{wait}{clear}

All right. Then I'll explain, just a little.{wait}{clear}Arcaya is made up of the Yerasel continent, the Kavakia peninsula and islands big and small, and it's divided into seven main lands.{wait}{clear}

Um, first, in the north of the continent is the Grosain Empire, the mightiest power in Arcaya.{wait}{clear}Its capital is Reizefut, in the Reizefut region. It covers about a third of the continent, in the north, and a third of its land is frozen tundra.{wait}{clear}It seems it was once a great empire that ruled the whole continent, so it has a very long history.{wait}{clear}It still seems to be a military nation with very disciplined knightly orders.{wait}{clear}
